merge_adapter: merge a PEFT adapter into a base causal LM and save the merged model and tokenizer
get_model: load and configure a causal language model with optional PEFT LoRA or Unsloth quantization
get_tokenizer: initialize a tokenizer with chat template support for chatml or zephyr formats
apply_chat_template: apply a chat template to dialogue examples for SFT reward or DPO training
configure_training_args: configure training arguments including batch size learning rate and gradient checkpointing for a language model
